project: API Cost Optimization — Find Best Verified Providers to Cut Costs
description: 35 agents to research verified AI API providers, grey market alternatives, consolidation strategies, and produce actionable cost-cutting recommendations with real website links

phases.name: Official AI API Provider Research

tasks.prompt:
Research OpenAI's CURRENT pricing as of 2025-2026 in detail.

For EACH model provide:
- Model name and version
- Input price per 1M tokens
- Output price per 1M tokens
- Context window
- Rate limits by tier
- Any batch/volume discounts
- Commitment pricing if available

Models to cover: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-3.5 Turbo, o1, o1-mini, DALL-E 3, Whisper, TTS, Embeddings (text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large).

Also research: OpenAI's enterprise tier pricing, Microsoft Azure OpenAI pricing differences, any recent price cuts or changes.

Provide the OFFICIAL pricing page URL: https://openai.com/api/pricing/
tasks.system_prompt: You are a cloud pricing analyst. Provide exact pricing figures from official sources. Include the official URL for every pricing claim.

tasks.prompt:
Research Anthropic's CURRENT Claude API pricing as of 2025-2026.

For EACH model:
- Model name (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 4 Sonnet, etc.)
- Input price per 1M tokens
- Output price per 1M tokens
- Context window
- Rate limits by tier
- Batch API pricing (50% discount?)
- Any volume discounts

Also research: Anthropic's enterprise pricing, AWS Bedrock Claude pricing (is it cheaper or more expensive than direct?), Google Cloud Vertex AI Claude pricing.

Provide the OFFICIAL pricing page URL: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing

Key question: What is the cheapest way to access Claude models?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a cloud pricing analyst. Provide exact pricing from official sources. Compare direct API vs cloud marketplace pricing.

tasks.prompt:
Research Google's AI API pricing as of 2025-2026.

Cover:
- Gemini 1.5 Pro pricing (input/output per 1M tokens)
- Gemini 1.5 Flash pricing
- Gemini 2.0 pricing if available
- Google Cloud Vertex AI pricing for Gemini
- Any free tiers (AI Studio gives free Gemini access?)
- Rate limits and quotas
- Batch processing discounts

Also research: How does Gemini pricing compare to GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet for equivalent capability? What are the actual cost savings?

Provide URLs: https://ai.google.dev/pricing, https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing
tasks.system_prompt: You are a cloud pricing analyst. Compare Google's AI pricing to competitors. Note any significant cost advantages or disadvantages.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL alternative AI API providers that offer cheaper access than OpenAI/Anthropic/Google.

Providers to research:
1. Mistral AI (mistral.ai) — pricing for Mistral Large, Medium, Small
2. Together AI (together.ai) — pricing for hosted open-source models
3. Groq (groq.com) — pricing for fast inference
4. Fireworks AI (fireworks.ai) — pricing
5. Deepseek (deepseek.com) — pricing for DeepSeek V3
6. Perplexity API (docs.perplexity.ai) — pricing
7. Cohere (cohere.com) — pricing for Command R+
8. Replicate (replicate.com) — pricing for open-source models
9. Anyscale/Endpoints — pricing
10. OpenRouter (openrouter.ai) — aggregator pricing

For EACH: exact pricing per 1M tokens (input/output), models available, free tiers, website URL, quality vs GPT-4o.

Key question: Which provider gives the best quality-per-dollar for each use case (chat, coding, analysis, embeddings)?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a cost optimization analyst. Rank providers by cost-effectiveness. Provide exact pricing with URLs.

tasks.prompt:
Research the ACTUAL cost of self-hosting open-source models as an alternative to paid APIs.

Models to analyze:
1. Llama 3.1 405B, 70B, 8B — what hardware needed? Monthly cost on cloud GPU?
2. Mistral Large — self-hosting cost
3. DeepSeek V3 — self-hosting cost
4. Qwen 2.5 72B — self-hosting cost
5. Command R+ — self-hosting cost

For each, calculate:
- Minimum GPU requirements (A100, H100, RTX 4090?)
- Cloud GPU rental cost (RunPod, Lambda, Vast.ai)
- Tokens per second throughput
- Cost per 1M tokens when self-hosted
- Break-even point vs API pricing

Also research: vLLM, TGI, Ollama deployment costs. What's the REALISTIC monthly cost for a self-hosted setup that replaces a $500/mo API bill?

Provide URLs for GPU pricing: runpod.io, lambdalabs.com, vast.ai
tasks.system_prompt: You are a cloud infrastructure cost analyst. Calculate realistic self-hosting costs including all hidden costs (storage, bandwidth, maintenance). Provide URLs.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL AI API proxy/aggregator services that consolidate multiple providers and offer cost savings.

Services to research:
1. OpenRouter (openrouter.ai) — How does it work? Pricing markup? Which models?
2. LiteLLM (litellm.ai) — Self-hosted proxy, no markup? Features?
3. Portkey (portkey.ai) — Gateway features, pricing?
4. Helicone (helicone.ai) — Observability + gateway, pricing?
5. Martian (withmartian.com) — Smart routing, pricing?
6. Braintrust Proxy — Features?
7. AI Gateway by Cloudflare — Features, pricing?

For EACH: How much money can it actually save? Does it add latency? What's the markup? Can it auto-route to cheapest model?

Key question: What is the BEST way to consolidate multiple AI API providers into one gateway to minimize costs?
tasks.system_prompt: You are an API infrastructure analyst. Focus on actual cost savings achievable through each aggregator. Provide exact pricing and URLs.

tasks.prompt:
Research ALL proven strategies for cutting AI API costs without sacrificing quality.

Strategies to investigate:
1. Prompt caching (Anthropic, OpenAI) — how much does it save? How to implement?
2. Batch API (OpenAI, Anthropic) — 50% savings? Tradeoffs?
3. Model cascading — use cheap model first, escalate to expensive model only when needed
4. Semantic caching — cache similar prompts, serve cached responses
5. Prompt compression — reduce token count without losing quality
6. Fine-tuning smaller models — when is it cheaper than using GPT-4o?
7. Token optimization — reduce input/output tokens
8. Commitment discounts — AWS Savings Plans, Azure Reserved Capacity
9. Multi-provider arbitrage — switch providers based on real-time pricing
10. Embedding optimization — use smaller embedding models for most tasks

For EACH strategy: estimated cost reduction (%), implementation complexity, quality impact, and a real example.

Key question: What combination of strategies can reduce a $1,000/mo AI API bill to $200/mo or less?
tasks.system_prompt: You are an AI cost optimization expert. Provide specific, actionable strategies with realistic savings estimates. Back up claims with evidence.

phases.synthesis_prompt:
Synthesize ALL pricing research into:
1. A comprehensive PRICE COMPARISON TABLE of all AI API providers (input/output per 1M tokens for comparable models)
2. The TOP 5 cheapest providers for each use case (chat, coding, embeddings, image gen)
3. The BEST cost-cutting strategies ranked by savings potential
4. A DECISION FRAMEWORK: when to use which provider
5. The MINIMUM viable cost for different usage levels ($100/mo, $500/mo, $1,000/mo, $5,000/mo)
6. All URLs for pricing pages

phases.name: Architecture & Implementation Planning

tasks.prompt:
Design a COST-OPTIMIZED AI API pipeline architecture for someone currently spending $500-$1,000/mo on AI APIs.

The architecture should:
1. Use LiteLLM or OpenRouter as a unified gateway
2. Route different request types to different providers based on cost/quality
3. Implement prompt caching (Anthropic native + semantic caching)
4. Implement model cascading (cheap model first → expensive only when needed)
5. Track costs per request, per model, per task type
6. Auto-failover between providers
7. Log all requests for optimization analysis

Provide:
- Architecture diagram (ASCII)
- Component list with verified tools and pricing
- Routing rules (which requests go to which provider)
- Expected cost reduction vs current single-provider setup
- Implementation timeline

Use ONLY verified tools — no fabricated products.

Context from Phase 1-2: {previous_synthesis}
tasks.system_prompt: You are a solutions architect. Design a practical, implementable architecture. Use only tools that actually exist. Provide setup instructions.
